section_3d8.change: Adds a remark on split-section degree and Jacobian annihilators; no prior theorem text or finite-results table is removed.
section_3d8.hypotheses: The same residue argument is stated for Fprime=F-R q_s q_minus_s, degree d in {1,2,3}, after resolving the common base locus. The automatic annihilators require the specifically stated symmetries.
section_3d8.d1: If Fprime retains separate sign changes of the two linear forms, the quartics partial_delta0(Fprime)/(2delta0) and partial_delta1(Fprime)/(2delta1) give two directions whose product with delta0delta1 lies in J(Fprime). They lower the effective moving dimension by two and do not contribute a nonzero two-form.
section_3d8.d3: With X2/Y2 exchange and the specified order-three action, and b=X2^3-Y2^3 fixed up to scale, (X2 partial_X2 - Y2 partial_Y2)Fprime is divisible by b. The resulting symmetric cubic H3 has bH3 in J(Fprime), absorbing one dot-a direction.
section_3d8.d2: The source says degree-five partials create no corresponding annihilator in S2; the existing two-dimensional kernel can produce the nonzero pairing checked in the original seed.
section_3d8.interpretation: A raw kernel/parameter surplus is insufficient if its directions lie in the Jacobian-annihilator subspace. This qualification limits the d1/d3 variants; it does not retract the d2 paired-exchange support result. No numerical raw surplus beyond the stated two/one lost directions is invented here.

section_4_6.change: Adds moving weighted-Fano extension deficits to the existing fixed-section density-map obstruction.
section_4_6.scope: These dimension deficits concern the proposed full Hodge-bundle submersion/dense-rational-Hodge-class mechanism for the specified extensions of a general even sextic. They do not obstruct divisor support from independently supplied cycles, smaller subvariations or different geometry.
section_4_6.heading: ## 4.6 Quotient representations and extension obstructions

cycle-q2.change: Adds the order-72 diagonal character sector, order-24 invariant subgroup, toric quotient limitations and a surviving-sign refinement of the threefold section count.
reported_counts: G72 sector Hodge type (6,26,6), with six-dimensional H^(3,1).
G24 quotient Newton polytope minimum lattice width three; ten width-three directions yield no zero-interior surface fibration.
G72 unique zero-interior surface fibration recovers cycle-three geometry, but target cube-root twist lifts to a non-uniruled elliptic surface with chi(O)=3 and target-character p_g=1.
Retaining s0,s1 with gamma reduces fiber h^(2,1) from33 to18; section space dimension5 with n-c=5-1-3=1.
cycle-q2.scope: Existing support/certificate existence remains asserted for this exact q=2 target under its paired-sign/order-three symmetry. Moving curves away from the Fermat seed and an explicit primitive remain non-explicit. This is not a newly accepted solve.

four-plus-two-residual.change: Explains why the newly accepted symmetric-sextic moving-line construction does not automatically transfer to its less symmetric core, and states the exact suspension equation.
reported_counts: Core projective diagonal symmetry only sigma:(Y0,Y1)->(-Y0,-Y1).
Binary boundary sextics irreducible over Q with S6 Galois group.
Anti-invariant H3(T,Q) dimension96, h^(2,1)=48; a curve correspondence spanning it needs parameter-curve genus at least48.
four-plus-two-residual.reduction: The source states 2A-2dH(v)+3H div(v)=0 with no F^2 remainder for the displayed suspension lift.
four-plus-two-residual.scope: Existing two-reflection support gives existence. Additional symmetry used by symmetric-sextic-residual is absent; an explicit rational primitive remains to be supplied. The genus bound is conditional on spanning the specified full sector, not a universal denominator obstruction.

quadric-contact-residual.change: Adds a comparison between its conic-bundle reduction and the symmetric-sextic cubic-surface mechanism.
reported_counts: Cross and linear terms remain in the two fiber coordinates.
Completing the square generically gives a quintic base surface; a specified two-parameter discriminant-factor slice gives a three-nodal quartic K3 surface, not a cubic surface.
quadric-contact-residual.scope: The paired-exchange theorem still supplies nonconstructive existence under its stated invariances. Neither cycles nor denominator are produced by that theorem; explicit certificate and formal target proof remain outstanding. New construction limitations do not revoke existence.

off-paired.change: Records additional surviving diagonal and exchange symmetry and explains why it does not serve the selected sector.
reported_counts: G36 target-fixed primitive Hodge numbers (0,22,50,22,0).
Adding X2/Y2 exchange gives nonabelian G72 with six reflections; all six act negatively on the selected sector.
off-paired.scope: Reflection quotients serve complementary sectors. An order-six quotient is a double cover with weighted-CY3-pencil structure whose holomorphic form is fixed by residual order-three symmetry. Only one pair exchange survives, so the two-exchange §3D.8 theorem does not apply directly; no unrestricted nonexistence conclusion.

one-reflection-skew.change: Adds exact surviving G24 character information and explains the obstruction to this fiberwise Hodge-locus route.
reported_counts: G24 generated by tau, s1 and Y2->zeta6 Y2.
Target character (1,1,zeta6); complex Hodge numbers (0,44,77,3,0), rational conjugate pair (0,47,154,47,0).
one-reflection-skew.scope: The paired-sign pencil gives weighted CY3 fibers whose holomorphic three-form has the same (1,zeta6) character as the target. This puts that target outside the stated Chapter3D fiberwise criteria. It is a boundary of those methods, not a nonexistence result for the unrestricted certificate.

klein-coupled-character.change: Adds the nontrivial target-character Hodge dimensions to the existing invariant-sector/target-character distinction.
reported_counts: Order14 diagonal-group target complex eigenspace (0,26,123,37,0); rational conjugate pair (0,63,246,63,0).
klein-coupled-character.scope: The order-seven invariant support mechanism serves nineteen H^(3,1) directions, while averaging kills this zeta^3 target. No existence theorem for the selected nontrivial character and no global impossibility theorem are asserted.

cyclic-triple-residual.change: Adds G18 structure, target-character Hodge dimensions and an age screen for the target-fixing subgroup.
reported_counts: G18 is C6 x C3.
Complex eigenspace (0,41,119,26,0); rational conjugate pair (0,67,238,67,0).
Order-six target-fixing subgroup; all nontrivial fixed strata have age at least one.
cyclic-triple-residual.scope: These are exclusions/screens of specified quotient and transport mechanisms. The weighted-Fano density theorem does not cover the selected cyclic character; the entry does not assert exhaustive obstruction.

quadratic-cubic-pullback.change: Strengthens the explanation why the general six-quadric pullback lies outside both orientations of the ternary-net theorem and its direct pair-transfer model.
reported_counts: Both bidegree contraction ranks are six, while either ternary-net orientation forces at most three under block-linear changes.
Degree-sixteen quotient cover gives a 120-sheeted unordered-pair cover.
The pair cover is birationally fibered in smooth genus-four (3,3) curves over a V4 quotient of a 45-nodal (3,3) CY3; smooth models have Kodaira dimension at least one.
quadratic-cubic-pullback.scope: The stated determinant-density source remains served, but it differs from this target. The calculations exclude these specific Fano/ternary-net transfers, not every correspondence or denominator.

eight-plane-configuration.change: Describes the natural residual surface fibration obtained from [Q0:Q1:Q2] and why it misses the p_g=0 criterion.
reported_counts: General fibers are smooth (2,2,4) complete intersections in P5.
K=O(2), p_g=19 and quotient p_g=9.
eight-plane-configuration.scope: The natural fibration is outside the p_g=0 surface criterion. Another family sweeping a divisor with the required Gysin image remains possible. The planes alone have (2,2) classes and do not serve the H^(3,1) target.

reflection-coupled-residual.change: Adds the precise primitive tau-invariant Hodge decomposition by the surviving Y2 reflection.
reported_counts: (208,866,208) splits into served Y2-odd (82,374,82) and target Y2-even (126,492,126).
reflection-coupled-residual.scope: The volume/density twist means the known quotient primitive serves only the complementary character. The entry gives no existence conclusion for this selected class and no unrestricted nonexistence conclusion.
